XData.name: PageContents
XData.Description: This XML block defines the contents of this pane.
XData.Data:
<pane xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" width="100%">
<hgroup valign="top" width="100%" align="left"> <!-- Create --> <vgroup valign="top" align="left" width="30%"> <fieldSet id="srcCtrlInFieldSet" legend=" Create / Find Deployment Files " width="100%"> <form id="srcCtrlInForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;" width="100%"> <text label="Component:" id="Component" name="Component" size="50"/> <text label="Namespace:" id="Namespace" name="Namespace" size="25"/>
</form>
<hgroup align="center"> <button caption="Create" onclick="zenPage.DoCreateFiles();" /> <spacer width="10"/> <button caption="Find" onclick="zenPage.FindFiles();" /> </hgroup> </fieldSet>
</vgroup> <!-- Deploy -->
<vgroup valign="top" align="center" width="30%"> <fieldSet id="deployFieldSet" hidden="false" legend=" Deploy Files " width="100%"> <form id="deployForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;"> <text label="Component:" id="deployComponent" name="Component" size="50" /> <text label="Namespace:" id="deployNamespace" name="Namespace" size="25"/> <hgroup> <label id="lblRev" value="Deployment revision # " /> <text id="deployRev" name="Rev" required="true" size="10" align="left"/> </hgroup>
<hgroup> <label id="lblfType" value="Deploy Type: " /> <combobox id="comboboxdeployType" editable="false" dropdownHeight="50" selectedIndex="1"> <option value="new" text="New"/> <option value="update" text="Update"/> </combobox> </hgroup>
<hgroup align="center"> <button id="buttonDep" caption="Deploy" onclick="zenPage.DoDeploy();" />
</hgroup> </form>
</fieldSet>
</vgroup>
<!-- Verify -->
<vgroup valign="top" align="right" width="30%" > <fieldSet id="verFieldSet" hidden="false" legend=" Verify Files " width="100%"> <form id="verForm" layout="vertical" cellStyle="padding: 2px; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px;"> <text label="Component:" id="verComponent" name="Component" size="50" /> <text label="Namespace:" id="verNamespace" name="Namespace" size="25" />
<hgroup align="center"> <button id="buttonVer" caption="Verify" onclick="zenPage.DoVerify();" />
</hgroup> </form>
</fieldSet>
</vgroup>
</hgroup> <label id="lblAccess" value="" />
</pane>
